profile.name: PI E-816压电定位控制器
profile.description: 用于控制压电位移台或压电执行器进行精密定位的控制器。该设备支持将通道移动到目标位置、读取当前位置，并查询控制就绪状态、通道相关状态以及位置上下限，常用于显微镜对焦和纳米级定位实验。
profile.description_en: A controller for precision positioning of a piezo stage or piezo actuator. It supports moving a channel to a target position, reading the current position, and querying control readiness, channel-related status, and motion limits. It is commonly used for microscope focusing and nanoscale positioning experiments.
